note: Room 3, the Bountiful Nugget. Its own depth curve, derived from its own architecture the way doc 36 Q10 did for Room 2 -- and it is a much closer view: the batwing doorway is 430px for about 2.0m and the near bar 220px for about 1.1m, which put a 1.75m man at 376 and 350 respectively. Two independent measurements agreeing means the plate is internally consistent, as Room 2’s was. An interior is simply nearer than a street.

scaling.note: height = 0.611 x (y - 211), from the doorway and the bar

entrances.note: Through the batwing doors on the left wall, facing right into the room. He was appearing in the middle of the floor because Room 3 declared no entrances at all -- the same fault Room 2 had, where the compiler wrote `entrance` and the engine reads `entrances`.
Anything else arrives by the door too.
